features.name: Top-mounted imaging scope and shock pad inconspicuously integrated into WALNUT WOOD stock. Material is source-specified, not an arbitrary all-metal conversion.
Own WILDHUTER image printed27/PDF29: long slender barrel, top scope, traditional wood stock/body with rear grip contour. Preserve hunting-rifle proportions.

PASS: Actual bolt-action hunting rifle retains long slender barrel, top imaging scope, traditional WALNUT WOOD body/stock with curved rear grip and modest integrated butt shock pad. Wood is source-constrained; shade/woodgrain and unseen depth are artistic. The rendered left-to-right display reverses the page orientation but preserves the own WILDHUTER silhouette/class rather than substituting adjacent Remington750. No added laser, bipod or suppressor. Sling eyelets, bolt lever and scope gaps remain structural; tiny pad vents/checkering/grain are appearance only. Actual matching clay has smooth stock/grip, pad and fittings with grain, checkering, pad vent slots, scope knurling, fine cuts and screw recesses filled. Broad scope mount bands, bolt/receiver fittings, stock-to-shockpad boundary and end cap are major part boundaries, not tiny ornamental cuts. Assigned sole reviewer inspected native/final independent masks, teal views and paired overlay. Genuine trigger guard, scope gap and two sling-eyelet holes, thin barrel and bolt lever preserved; metallic white barrel/receiver highlights remain foreground, not transparent holes. No clipped muzzle, missing member, detached foreground, broad fringe or cast shadow. Raw RGB unchanged; common crop/scale/offset only. 2048 output is resampled from1254 square, not native2K. Reference approval only.
